title: t27c on gfternary.t27 -- phi-scaled ternary weights, native
desc: t27c 0.4.0 and zig 0.16.0 on the t27c lab (Railway), spec at t27 5ff0ec512: 13 tests pass natively, 8 of them with no runtime assert; dropping the reserved-code fold makes exactly one test fail; git restores the spec.
commands: t27c gen specs/numeric/gfternary.t27 > gfternary.zig && zig test gfternary.zig
sed -i 's/return if (c == GAT_RSVD) GAT_ZERO else c;/return c;/' specs/numeric/gfternary.t27 && git diff -U0 | tail -n 2
